signal_definition: One linked earnings-release exhibit per accession. For each complete nonoverlapping fragment, p(positive)-p(negative); weight by exact normalized-character span length. Exclude failed, truncated, duplicated, overlapping or incompletely covered fragments/documents. Do not combine primary and exhibit scores.
development_status: 2024-2025 already inspected elsewhere; this arm uses2024 only and grants no untouched-test claim
universe_basis: Existing four-REIT convenience pilot; historical listing/identity proof still required; no whole-sector inference
processing_latency_basis: Named historical research assumption added to independently supported exact-text public upper bound; does not reconstruct actual receipt/processing or earliest-public time
decision_schedule: first reference exchange session whose open follows supported public upper bound plus processing latency; signal ready by session open; decide/enter at open+60s; exit at actual close-60s
cost_policy: Externally evidenced entry/exit commissions, spread, slippage, exact-horizon borrow and collateral obligations; absent costs are unknown, explicit qualified zero allowed; no invented schedule
corporate_action_policy: Only evidenced verified-none same-session coverage is supported by existing engine; unsupported actual actions invalidate economic report, preserving opportunities and exclusions
exit_missingness_policy: Future exit quote/size cannot alter ex-ante opportunities or position sizing; missing outcome/execution evidence invalidates headline comparison rather than select survivors
regular_mark_policy: One mark after all exits at each reference-session close; no-trade days carried with zero cash yield; assert all positions, collateral and restricted proceeds flat at each mark
sharpe_reference: zero cash return; descriptive annualized daily marked-account Sharpe only with sufficient nonzero return variation; no conditional interval invented
sharpe_confidence_interval_owner: Research Sharpe confidence intervals; null unless supported methodology and sample accepted
economic_stop_rule: If required evidence is missing or any reserved order cannot reconcile, insufficient evidence with null strategy metrics; valid weak evidence may conclude no trade. No numeric promotion threshold was supplied.
preexisting_inspection: Existing fragment scores and other market diagnostics were examined previously. This freezes event aggregation/policy before new event scoring and economic replay; not a claim of pristine model/data discovery.
optional_gpu_boundary: Existing CPU portfolio default. GPU math optimization is independent and does not alter clocks, masks, costs, decisions or economics; no driver/runtime change or competing job here.
